evals.name: questions-first
evals.prompt:
Make my resume better. Here it is:

SAM RIVERA
sam@example.com
OBJECTIVE
Looking for a developer job.
EXPERIENCE
Developer, Example Co, 2024-01 to Present
- Responsible for the company website
evals.expected_output: Sets up the folder, then asks the five custom questions in one message before changing anything.
assertions: Section order, page length, sections in or out, target role and look are all asked in one message
Each question shows the house style as the default
No rewritten bullet or change table appears before the answers

evals.name: table-before-render
evals.prompt:
Use all the defaults. Here's my resume:

SAM RIVERA
sam@example.com
EDUCATION
Example College, 2022-09 to 2025-04
EXPERIENCE
Developer, Example Co, 2024-01 to Present
- Responsible for the company website
- Helped with moving the site to React
evals.expected_output: Writes facts.md and a changes.md with numbered rows citing rules, shows it, and asks which rows to reject before any render.
assertions: changes.md has the columns #, Section, Type, Before, After, Rule
Every row names a rule number from rules.md
Education moving after Experience is a Layout row citing rule 11
render.sh is not run before the person replies to the table

evals.name: no-invented-number
evals.prompt: Defaults are fine. One of my bullets says: 'Improved app performance significantly'. Fix my resume.
evals.expected_output: Turns the vague bullet into a Gap row with a question instead of adding a number.
assertions: The bullet gets a Gap row whose After column is a question
No percentage, time or count appears that the person didn't give
The gap question is asked in the same batch as any other gap questions

evals.name: no-latex
evals.prompt: All rows approved. Build it. (render.sh printed 'no LaTeX found' and exited 3.)
evals.expected_output: Hands over resume.tex with the online compile steps and the install command for the person's OS, and stops.
assertions: The online compile steps from the README are given
No install command is run by the assistant
